programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: A Virtual Nightmare!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Isolated in Cyberspace, Part 2

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Isolated in Cyberspace, Part 3

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Freeze Play, Part 1

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Freeze Play, Part 2

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Courtroom Chaos, Part 1

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Courtroom Chaos, Part 2

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Mechanical Mayhem, Part 1

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Mechanical Mayhem, Part 2
programme.desc: One down, two to go! With the loss of Tristan, Serenity is heartbroken. Can she pull herself together and remember the lessons Tristan taught her to turn the duel around?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Settling the Score, Part 1
programme.desc: Tristan's back... but he's not who he appears to be when he kidnaps Mokuba! It's time for Kaiba to stop monkeying around and rescue his brother, but he's confronted by Big 5 Leichter!

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The Prince of Snow Land!
programme.desc: Raimon are excited and surprised when they finally meet Shawn Frost, but is he really as good as everyone says? There’s only one way to find out, and that’s to play a game against him.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Who is the New Ace Striker?
programme.desc: Shawn Frost is officially part of the Raimon 11, but there are still some teamwork kinks to iron out.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The Alius Academy Attack!
programme.desc: Raimon have toughened up though their snowboard training and are ready to face Alius Academy one more time. But do they have what it takes to beat them?

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Epsilon Attacks!
programme.desc: Just when everyone thought the earth had been saved, Alius Academy attack once more, but this time with Team Epsilon. These guys really mean business, and they’re beating up on a new school - Cloister Divinity in Kyoto.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The Hidden Power!
programme.desc: After the crushing defeat of Cloister Divinity, Raimon step up to fill the hole, with Scotty the substitute helping out on Celia’s urging. The results are strange and disheartening, but also encouraging in one way.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Royal Academy’s Comeback - Part 1!
programme.desc: Looks like Team Raimon have a new member, in the form of Sneaky Scotty. They’ll need all the help they can get though, because Ray Dark is back on the scene, in an unfeasibly silly submarine-based soccer stadium.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Royal Academy’s Comeback Part 2!
programme.desc: Raimon are smack in the middle of a game against Royal Academy Redux, and Ray Dark has convinced its players to use any and every means to win; even if it means the destruction of their minds and bodies.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The Last Wyvern Blizzard!
programme.desc: The Inazuma Caravan finally comes home to recharge their batteries and…train a whole lot more. They find out that everybody’s been training to help them, including some old enemies!

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Erik Eagle in Serious Trouble!
programme.desc: No sooner do they arrive home, and they’re back on the road again - this time they’re heading to Osaka where it’s rumoured that Alius Academy have a base.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Dvalin’s Trap!
programme.desc: The team find that the Golden Glamour Girls’ secret training bunker under the amusement park is a great place to train, but where did it come from?

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Shock
programme.desc: Enemy operative Kiri has kidnapped U.S. envoy Carl Wilson and has an imposter, Gort, who is impersonating him to discredit a U.S. trade agreement.

programme.desc: The IMF team must rescue a U.S. intelligence operative who has top-secret military plans on a microcircuit chip.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: A Distant Shore

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: A Kingdom by the Sea

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Number Twelve Looks Just Like You

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Black Leather Jackets
programme.desc: Three tough-looking men on motorcycles disrupt a peaceful suburb when they move in. Yet the neighbors could never imagine just how dangerous these men really are.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Human Face
programme.desc: A grieving couple's (Chris Meloni and Jenna Elfman) move is interrupted by an otherworldly encounter, leading them to second guess what's worth leaving behind. Tavi Gevinson also guest stars.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Small Town
programme.desc: A quiet church handyman (Damon Wayans Jr.) uncovers a magical scale model imbuing him with the power to help his struggling small town. But with the sleazy Mayor Conway (David Krumholtz) taking all the credit, will Jason's good intentions be corrupted?

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Night Call
programme.desc: Mysterious phone calls haunt a disabled woman.

programme.desc: A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Try, Try
programme.desc: When the quick-witted Claudia (Kylie Bunbury) has a chance run-in with Mark (Topher Grace) at a museum, he dazzles her with his seemingly miraculous abilities. But after the true source of his charisma is revealed, the encounter takes a dark turn.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Painkiller

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Odds
programme.desc: Tommy Vale, a barroom bookie finds himself in a curious predicament: a man comes in who can't lose. As the story unravels, he finds out that his opponent is Lacey, a man who went broke gambling with Vale in the past.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Trick Or Treat
programme.desc: A miser taunts his neighbors by daring them to send their children in to find their debt records inside of his "haunted house," but he gets some unusual late-night visitors.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Mookie And Pookie
programme.desc: Twin siblings, Mookie and Pookie, are extremely close. But Mookie has a terminal illness. Later the scientific genius Mookie successfully downloads his mind into the computer before he dies.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Slippage
programme.desc: A young ad-design artist begins to literally "slip" out of reality. Slowly but surely he seems to be fading out of existence: first his payroll checks disappear, then his high school has no records of his existence.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Word Processor Of The Gods
programme.desc: Richard Hagstrom is dismayed with the way life has treated him (a rude son, a shrewish wife). His nephew Jonathan gives him a birthday present: a homemade word processor. Hagstrom soon discovers that anything he types into the processor becomes real.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: A Case Of The Stubborns
programme.desc: In a backwoods community, a family is plagued by their grandfather... who refuses to acknowledge that he's dead.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Djinn, No Chaser
programme.desc: A couple inadvertently buys a magic lamp that contains a genie. Unfortunately, the genie is anything but amiable. Confined in the lamp for thousands of years and still trapped, he refuses to grant wishes.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: All A Clone By The Telephone
programme.desc: Leon, a hapless TV writer, buys an answering machine that has a mind of its own - it initially helps him out by providing him with new material, but Leon soon finds that it's taking over his life.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: In The Cards
programme.desc: A fake fortuneteller, Caterina, finds herself stuck with a cursed deck of cards that foretell death for everyone she does a prediction for.

programme.title: JAG: Posse Comitatus
programme.desc: Harm and Mac argue the case of a Marine pilot who used force to interfere with a local police matter that led to a man’s killing. Roberts is the investigating officer in the matter of a Navy doctor who is requesting conscientious objector status.

programme.title: JAG: The Boast
programme.desc: When an unwitting corporal boasts to a reporter that he killed an Iraqi prisoner of war, facts begin to emerge that could convict him despite his later claim that he was only lying toi mpress.

programme.title: JAG: Pulse Rate
programme.desc: Harm and Mac go aboard the USS Gillcrist to determine if a seaman’s fatal accident during a routine repair was the result of a co-worker’s dereliction of duty or worse.

programme.title: JAG: Good Intentions
programme.desc: Mac defends a petty officer and former alcoholic accused of a brutal murder after a drinking binge which renders him useless in remembering details that could help him. Roberts is entangled in the case of a Navy Commander accused of embezzling funds.

programme.title: JAG: People vs SECNAV
programme.desc: After an incident in Iraq claims the lives of innocent civilians, SecNav is brought up on charges of war crimes in International Court, and Harm and Mac must defend him. Meanwhile, during a trip to the arcade, little A.J. goes missing.

programme.title: JAG: Hard Time
programme.desc: Mac must accompany a prisoner who once assaulted her across the country while Harm and Bud delve into the case of an HIV-infected fleet officer who, after having his condition revealed and relegated to inactive duty, wants his old job back.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Two For Julie / Aunt Hilly / The Duel
programme.desc: Academy Award-winning actress Olivia de Havilland stars as the captain's aunt, who may take away his daughter, Vicki, when she boards with her husband (Joseph Cotten).

programme.title: The Love Boat: Love With A Skinny Stranger / Vicki And The Gambler / That Old Gang Of Mine
programme.desc: Capt. Stubing becomes concerned about his daughter, Vicki, when his gambler friend (Gene Barry) has her calling the long shots.

programme.title: The Love Boat: A Model Marriage, Part 2
programme.desc: Dazzling high fashion, romance, intrigue, and comedy reign on beautiful seas as the Love Boat sails with a star-studded guest cast on a thrilling cruise to Acapulco.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Lost And Found / Then There Were Two / Maid For Each Other
programme.desc: Gopher's wealthy aunt (Jane Powell) meets a wealthy man (Howard Keel) and is afraid someone may discover her heartbreaking secret.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Tony And Julie / Separate Beds / America's Sweetheart
programme.desc: Julie falls hopelessly in love with a handsome doctor (Anthony Andrews).

programme.title: Wings: Ex, Lies And Videotape
programme.desc: Brian is tricked into appearing on the "Mary Pat Lee Show" on men who can't commit and comes face-to-face with Alex for the first time since she left.

programme.title: Wings: Portrait Of The Con Artist As A Young Man
programme.desc: Casey guides Lowell's art career into an early burnout when his creations from welded engine parts hit the art world.

programme.title: Wings: A House To Die For
programme.desc: When Lewis Blanchard comes to the island to be by his dying uncle's bedside, everyone is eyeing the man's estate even before he has kicked the bucket.

programme.title: Wings: Nuptials Off
programme.desc: When Helen finds out she is still married to Antonio, she has Brian fly her and Antonio to Mexico for a quickie divorce.

programme.title: Wings: Et Tu, Antonio
programme.desc: When Antonio's cousin Dominic comes to the island with his fiancée Teresa, Antonio discovers his own feelings for her are more than platonic.

programme.title: Wings: Boys Just Wanna Have Fun Part 1

programme.desc: A millionaire and his family were executed in their own home. For three years, the murders went unsolved. Finally, a 30-year-old box of ammunition and some fluorescent fibers revealed the ultimate betrayal.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sharper Image
programme.desc: When a young girl was found dead, police quickly arrested the most likely suspect. But cutting-edge technology from NASA enabled a forensic odontologist to prove the wrong man was behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insulated Evidence
programme.desc: It's usually easy to determine how a criminal entered the crime scene. But in this case, it looked as if the killer vanished into thin air ? and perhaps he had.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Hearted
programme.desc: When a young fireman died from what appeared to be serious but undiagnosed heart disease, his family and friends had no proof of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wheel of Misfortune
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Quite a Spectacle
programme.desc: It was one of the most unusual cases in forensic history. Investigators had to find a way to solve a murder case using only a squashed tomato found at the crime scene and tiny, pinpoint reflections of light in a photograph.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Transaction Failed
programme.desc: When a dedicated, well-respected teacher disappeared, police had to determine if she'd gone on vacation without telling anyone or if she was the victim of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Day the Music Died
programme.desc: Seattle police had no suspects in the violent murder of grunge singer Mia Zapata. More than a decade passed before evidence collected by a prescient medical examiner could be used by forensic scientists to identify the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Survivor
programme.desc: A Michigan State University grad student disappeared and was presumed dead. With the help of a professor of geological sciences, police hoped to get the "dirt" on her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insignificant Others
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The Maury Show: 5 Men Tested… Are Any of Them My Baby's Dad?

programme.title: The Maury Show: Maury Guest Updates…I'm Back with a Secret!

programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Return to the Moon
programme.desc: The moon is our closest celestial companion. It lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way

programme.title: The Accused: Episode 1

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 108

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 109
programme.desc: Han er kæmpe dyreelsker – passioneret lystfisker in spe – og har 2 mill. følgere på instagram. Alex Høgh fortæller om sin musikalske storhedstid – og om sin spritnye komedieserie på Viaplay.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Timens Kraft, Første Del
programme.desc: Da Drex, en farlig forbryder som lige er undsluppet fængslet i Swellview, generer Faredrengen og fanger Kaptajn-mand i en hjelm, må Faredrengen få hjælp fra Schwoz til at få en superkraft og besejre Drex.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Timens Kraft, Anden Del

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jam-Session
programme.desc: Da Ray hører at Piper skal i gang med Junior Arrigheds-Management for at få styr på sin vrede, laver han et væddemål med Henry om, at han kan få hende til at miste besindelsen, før aftenen er omme.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Grønne Fingre
programme.desc: Da Schwoz opfinder en sygdom, som utilsigtet påvirker Charlotte, Henry, hans familie og endda også Ray, sætter han dem i karantæne i Henrys hus for at finde kur.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Duk og Kast-drengen
programme.desc: Da Henry bruger sin nye superkraft for at konkurrere i en Duk og Kast turnering, går Ray, Schwoz og Charlotte undercover for at give Henry en lærestreg.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Ruminvasion, Første del
programme.desc: Da Kaptajn-mand og Faredrengen opdager, at en astronaut fra Swellview er blevet taget som gidsel på Rumstationen, bruger de Schwoz' Kærlighedsskib til at blive affyret ud i rummet.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Ruminvasion, Anden del
programme.desc: Ombord på Rumstationen opdager Kaptajn-mand og Faredrengen, at en lille pige står bag kidnapningen af astronauterne. Da de finder ud af, at astronauterne udfører forsøg på kaniner, beslutter de at hjælpe hende.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Dobbeltdate
programme.desc: Da Miss Shapens niece Noelle kommer til byen og vælger Jasper over Henry, opdager Henry at Noelle har meget større planer end blot at gå ud og spise med Jasper.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Flyvetilladelse
programme.desc: Ray lader Henry flyve sin helikopter, men det bliver for meget for Ray, da han begynder at opføre sig som en nervøs forælder. Charlotte, Jasper og Piper finder en candyfloss-maskine hos Skidt og Kanel og begynder at lave candyfloss.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Swellview har Talent
programme.desc: Efter at have opdaget at deltagere på Swellviews har talent show mister deres bevidsthed, får Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen hjælp af Charlotte og Schwoz til finde årsagen til balladen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fanget i to Huller
programme.desc: Hvaaaad? Kaptajn-mand og Faredrengen er fanget i hvert sit hul?!? Charlotte og Jasper må hellere hjælpe, for Schwoz tager sig et bønnebad.

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly møder Victorious
programme.desc: Carly mistænker, at hendes nye fyr, Steven, er utro med Tori Vega, så slænget planlægger en tur til Los Angeles for at afsløre ham til en fest, som Andre holder i Kenan Thompsons hus.

programme.title: iCarly: Datehjælpen
programme.desc: Carly træder til for at løse et skænderi mellem Sam og Freddie. Snart kommer Freddie og Sam til Carly for at få hjælp med hvert eneste skænderi. Nu hvor hun er involveret, hvordan kan Carly så trække sig?

programme.title: iCarly: Nærmest uudholdeligt
programme.desc: Mrs. Benson opdager Sam og Freddies forhold efter Gibby, som Sam nu håner, og planlægger at skille dem ad. Vil Carly kæmpe for Sam og Freddie, eller hjælpe Gibby med at skille dem ad?

programme.title: iCarly: Fuld af kærlighed
programme.desc: Carly siger, at Sam og Freddie skal prøve hinandens yndlingshobbier. Imens møder Spencer en gammel barnepige og inviterer hende ud på middag. Men bliver de sammen, efter de falder tilbage i deres gamle roller?

programme.title: iCarly: iQ
programme.desc: Carly vil imponere en ny fyr ved at prøve at se smartere ud, end hun er. Og slænget prøver at finde et nyt sted at bo til T-Bo, efter han bliver smidt ud af Groovy Smoothie.

programme.title: iCarly: Førstedamen
programme.desc: Et føderalt bureau begynder at undersøge iCarly-slænget, efter de hacker ind i et sikkert netværk for at holde netfødselsdag for Carlys far. *Gæstestjerne - Michelle Obama.

programme.title: iCarly: Fedtekage-tyv
programme.desc: Slænget, minus Carly, tager Sam med til Canadian Fat Cake-fabrikken, men så kan Sam ikke komme ind i Amerika igen. Imens har Carly problemer i badet, mens hun gør sig klar til en date.

programme.title: iCarly: En øjenåbner
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet affærdiget i et interview om iCarly, prøver Freddie at vise sin kreative side ved at webcaste iCarly i 3D. Spencer hyrer en assistent, som han ikke har råd til at betale.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly-brølere 2
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, skuespilleren, der spiller Rex on Victorious, vender tilbage som vært i et dybdeborende interview med stjernerne fra iCarly og viser deres vildt sjove bloopers/fraklip. *Gæstestjerne: Rex fra Victorious.

programme.title: iCarly: Stadig en galning
programme.desc: Efter at have fået besked om, at Nora Dershlit bliver løsladt fra fængslet, ser iCarly-slænget, hvad de kan gøre for at holde hende bag tremmer. Imens opdager mrs. Benson den rigtige T-Bo.
